name: housing_diameter_max
expr: min(160 mm, floor((2 * wall_min + 3 * tooth_module + 125 * tooth_module) / 1 mm) * 1 mm)

name: ring_teeth_needed
expr: ceil(max(max(2 * (planet_teeth_min + 0.5) * (reduction - 1) / (reduction - 2) + teeth_step_bound, 2 * (motor_recess_radius + 1.2 mm + fit_clearance_most + 1.35 * tooth_module) / tooth_module + teeth_step_bound + 0.5), max((sun_teeth_min + 0.5) * (reduction - 1) + teeth_step_bound, (70 + teeth_step_bound) * (reduction - 1) / reduction)))

name: planets_4_shift
expr: max(1.02 - planets_4_sun * sin(pressure_angle)^2 / 2, 0) - max(1.02 - planets_4_planet * sin(pressure_angle)^2 / 2, 0)

name: planets_4_gap
expr: tooth_module * (planets_4_sun + planets_4_planet) * sin(180 deg / 4) - tooth_module * planets_4_planet - 2 * tooth_module * (1 - planets_4_shift)

name: planets_5_shift
expr: max(1.02 - planets_5_sun * sin(pressure_angle)^2 / 2, 0) - max(1.02 - planets_5_planet * sin(pressure_angle)^2 / 2, 0)

name: planets_5_gap
expr: tooth_module * (planets_5_sun + planets_5_planet) * sin(180 deg / 5) - tooth_module * planets_5_planet - 2 * tooth_module * (1 - planets_5_shift)

name: planets_6_shift
expr: max(1.02 - planets_6_sun * sin(pressure_angle)^2 / 2, 0) - max(1.02 - planets_6_planet * sin(pressure_angle)^2 / 2, 0)

name: planets_6_gap
expr: tooth_module * (planets_6_sun + planets_6_planet) * sin(180 deg / 6) - tooth_module * planets_6_planet - 2 * tooth_module * (1 - planets_6_shift)

name: planet_count_max
expr: if(planets_4_gap >= 1 mm, if(planets_5_gap >= 1 mm, if(planets_6_gap >= 1 mm, 6, 5), 4), 3)

name: sun_arc_x0
expr: ((sun_flank_x0^2 + sun_flank_y0^2) * (sun_flank_y1 - sun_flank_y2) + (sun_flank_x1^2 + sun_flank_y1^2) * (sun_flank_y2 - sun_flank_y0) + (sun_flank_x2^2 + sun_flank_y2^2) * (sun_flank_y0 - sun_flank_y1)) / (2 * (sun_flank_x0 * (sun_flank_y1 - sun_flank_y2) + sun_flank_x1 * (sun_flank_y2 - sun_flank_y0) + sun_flank_x2 * (sun_flank_y0 - sun_flank_y1)))

name: sun_arc_y0
expr: ((sun_flank_x0^2 + sun_flank_y0^2) * (sun_flank_x2 - sun_flank_x1) + (sun_flank_x1^2 + sun_flank_y1^2) * (sun_flank_x0 - sun_flank_x2) + (sun_flank_x2^2 + sun_flank_y2^2) * (sun_flank_x1 - sun_flank_x0)) / (2 * (sun_flank_x0 * (sun_flank_y1 - sun_flank_y2) + sun_flank_x1 * (sun_flank_y2 - sun_flank_y0) + sun_flank_x2 * (sun_flank_y0 - sun_flank_y1)))

name: sun_arc_x1
expr: ((sun_flank_x2^2 + sun_flank_y2^2) * (sun_flank_y3 - sun_flank_y4) + (sun_flank_x3^2 + sun_flank_y3^2) * (sun_flank_y4 - sun_flank_y2) + (sun_flank_x4^2 + sun_flank_y4^2) * (sun_flank_y2 - sun_flank_y3)) / (2 * (sun_flank_x2 * (sun_flank_y3 - sun_flank_y4) + sun_flank_x3 * (sun_flank_y4 - sun_flank_y2) + sun_flank_x4 * (sun_flank_y2 - sun_flank_y3)))

name: sun_arc_y1
expr: ((sun_flank_x2^2 + sun_flank_y2^2) * (sun_flank_x4 - sun_flank_x3) + (sun_flank_x3^2 + sun_flank_y3^2) * (sun_flank_x2 - sun_flank_x4) + (sun_flank_x4^2 + sun_flank_y4^2) * (sun_flank_x3 - sun_flank_x2)) / (2 * (sun_flank_x2 * (sun_flank_y3 - sun_flank_y4) + sun_flank_x3 * (sun_flank_y4 - sun_flank_y2) + sun_flank_x4 * (sun_flank_y2 - sun_flank_y3)))

name: sun_arc_x2
expr: ((sun_flank_x4^2 + sun_flank_y4^2) * (sun_flank_y5 - sun_flank_y6) + (sun_flank_x5^2 + sun_flank_y5^2) * (sun_flank_y6 - sun_flank_y4) + (sun_flank_x6^2 + sun_flank_y6^2) * (sun_flank_y4 - sun_flank_y5)) / (2 * (sun_flank_x4 * (sun_flank_y5 - sun_flank_y6) + sun_flank_x5 * (sun_flank_y6 - sun_flank_y4) + sun_flank_x6 * (sun_flank_y4 - sun_flank_y5)))

name: sun_arc_y2
expr: ((sun_flank_x4^2 + sun_flank_y4^2) * (sun_flank_x6 - sun_flank_x5) + (sun_flank_x5^2 + sun_flank_y5^2) * (sun_flank_x4 - sun_flank_x6) + (sun_flank_x6^2 + sun_flank_y6^2) * (sun_flank_x5 - sun_flank_x4)) / (2 * (sun_flank_x4 * (sun_flank_y5 - sun_flank_y6) + sun_flank_x5 * (sun_flank_y6 - sun_flank_y4) + sun_flank_x6 * (sun_flank_y4 - sun_flank_y5)))

name: planet_arc_x0
expr: ((planet_flank_x0^2 + planet_flank_y0^2) * (planet_flank_y1 - planet_flank_y2) + (planet_flank_x1^2 + planet_flank_y1^2) * (planet_flank_y2 - planet_flank_y0) + (planet_flank_x2^2 + planet_flank_y2^2) * (planet_flank_y0 - planet_flank_y1)) / (2 * (planet_flank_x0 * (planet_flank_y1 - planet_flank_y2) + planet_flank_x1 * (planet_flank_y2 - planet_flank_y0) + planet_flank_x2 * (planet_flank_y0 - planet_flank_y1)))

name: planet_arc_y0
expr: ((planet_flank_x0^2 + planet_flank_y0^2) * (planet_flank_x2 - planet_flank_x1) + (planet_flank_x1^2 + planet_flank_y1^2) * (planet_flank_x0 - planet_flank_x2) + (planet_flank_x2^2 + planet_flank_y2^2) * (planet_flank_x1 - planet_flank_x0)) / (2 * (planet_flank_x0 * (planet_flank_y1 - planet_flank_y2) + planet_flank_x1 * (planet_flank_y2 - planet_flank_y0) + planet_flank_x2 * (planet_flank_y0 - planet_flank_y1)))

name: planet_arc_x1
expr: ((planet_flank_x2^2 + planet_flank_y2^2) * (planet_flank_y3 - planet_flank_y4) + (planet_flank_x3^2 + planet_flank_y3^2) * (planet_flank_y4 - planet_flank_y2) + (planet_flank_x4^2 + planet_flank_y4^2) * (planet_flank_y2 - planet_flank_y3)) / (2 * (planet_flank_x2 * (planet_flank_y3 - planet_flank_y4) + planet_flank_x3 * (planet_flank_y4 - planet_flank_y2) + planet_flank_x4 * (planet_flank_y2 - planet_flank_y3)))

name: planet_arc_y1
expr: ((planet_flank_x2^2 + planet_flank_y2^2) * (planet_flank_x4 - planet_flank_x3) + (planet_flank_x3^2 + planet_flank_y3^2) * (planet_flank_x2 - planet_flank_x4) + (planet_flank_x4^2 + planet_flank_y4^2) * (planet_flank_x3 - planet_flank_x2)) / (2 * (planet_flank_x2 * (planet_flank_y3 - planet_flank_y4) + planet_flank_x3 * (planet_flank_y4 - planet_flank_y2) + planet_flank_x4 * (planet_flank_y2 - planet_flank_y3)))

name: planet_arc_x2
expr: ((planet_flank_x4^2 + planet_flank_y4^2) * (planet_flank_y5 - planet_flank_y6) + (planet_flank_x5^2 + planet_flank_y5^2) * (planet_flank_y6 - planet_flank_y4) + (planet_flank_x6^2 + planet_flank_y6^2) * (planet_flank_y4 - planet_flank_y5)) / (2 * (planet_flank_x4 * (planet_flank_y5 - planet_flank_y6) + planet_flank_x5 * (planet_flank_y6 - planet_flank_y4) + planet_flank_x6 * (planet_flank_y4 - planet_flank_y5)))

name: planet_arc_y2
expr: ((planet_flank_x4^2 + planet_flank_y4^2) * (planet_flank_x6 - planet_flank_x5) + (planet_flank_x5^2 + planet_flank_y5^2) * (planet_flank_x4 - planet_flank_x6) + (planet_flank_x6^2 + planet_flank_y6^2) * (planet_flank_x5 - planet_flank_x4)) / (2 * (planet_flank_x4 * (planet_flank_y5 - planet_flank_y6) + planet_flank_x5 * (planet_flank_y6 - planet_flank_y4) + planet_flank_x6 * (planet_flank_y4 - planet_flank_y5)))

name: planet_bearing_row
expr: if(planet_bearings[4].outside / 2 <= planet_bearing_room, 4, if(planet_bearings[3].outside / 2 <= planet_bearing_room, 3, if(planet_bearings[2].outside / 2 <= planet_bearing_room, 2, 1)))

name: output_row
expr: if(housing_diameter >= 130 mm, 3, if(housing_diameter >= 115 mm || hub_radius_needed > 10 mm, 2, 1))

name: flange_radius
expr: clamp(0.32 * housing_diameter, hub_radius + 8 mm, housing_radius - wall_min - 2 mm)

name: ring_arc_x0
expr: ((ring_flank_x0^2 + ring_flank_y0^2) * (ring_flank_y1 - ring_flank_y2) + (ring_flank_x1^2 + ring_flank_y1^2) * (ring_flank_y2 - ring_flank_y0) + (ring_flank_x2^2 + ring_flank_y2^2) * (ring_flank_y0 - ring_flank_y1)) / (2 * (ring_flank_x0 * (ring_flank_y1 - ring_flank_y2) + ring_flank_x1 * (ring_flank_y2 - ring_flank_y0) + ring_flank_x2 * (ring_flank_y0 - ring_flank_y1)))

name: ring_arc_y0
expr: ((ring_flank_x0^2 + ring_flank_y0^2) * (ring_flank_x2 - ring_flank_x1) + (ring_flank_x1^2 + ring_flank_y1^2) * (ring_flank_x0 - ring_flank_x2) + (ring_flank_x2^2 + ring_flank_y2^2) * (ring_flank_x1 - ring_flank_x0)) / (2 * (ring_flank_x0 * (ring_flank_y1 - ring_flank_y2) + ring_flank_x1 * (ring_flank_y2 - ring_flank_y0) + ring_flank_x2 * (ring_flank_y0 - ring_flank_y1)))

name: ring_arc_x1
expr: ((ring_flank_x2^2 + ring_flank_y2^2) * (ring_flank_y3 - ring_flank_y4) + (ring_flank_x3^2 + ring_flank_y3^2) * (ring_flank_y4 - ring_flank_y2) + (ring_flank_x4^2 + ring_flank_y4^2) * (ring_flank_y2 - ring_flank_y3)) / (2 * (ring_flank_x2 * (ring_flank_y3 - ring_flank_y4) + ring_flank_x3 * (ring_flank_y4 - ring_flank_y2) + ring_flank_x4 * (ring_flank_y2 - ring_flank_y3)))

name: ring_arc_y1
expr: ((ring_flank_x2^2 + ring_flank_y2^2) * (ring_flank_x4 - ring_flank_x3) + (ring_flank_x3^2 + ring_flank_y3^2) * (ring_flank_x2 - ring_flank_x4) + (ring_flank_x4^2 + ring_flank_y4^2) * (ring_flank_x3 - ring_flank_x2)) / (2 * (ring_flank_x2 * (ring_flank_y3 - ring_flank_y4) + ring_flank_x3 * (ring_flank_y4 - ring_flank_y2) + ring_flank_x4 * (ring_flank_y2 - ring_flank_y3)))

name: ring_arc_x2
expr: ((ring_flank_x4^2 + ring_flank_y4^2) * (ring_flank_y5 - ring_flank_y6) + (ring_flank_x5^2 + ring_flank_y5^2) * (ring_flank_y6 - ring_flank_y4) + (ring_flank_x6^2 + ring_flank_y6^2) * (ring_flank_y4 - ring_flank_y5)) / (2 * (ring_flank_x4 * (ring_flank_y5 - ring_flank_y6) + ring_flank_x5 * (ring_flank_y6 - ring_flank_y4) + ring_flank_x6 * (ring_flank_y4 - ring_flank_y5)))

name: ring_arc_y2
expr: ((ring_flank_x4^2 + ring_flank_y4^2) * (ring_flank_x6 - ring_flank_x5) + (ring_flank_x5^2 + ring_flank_y5^2) * (ring_flank_x4 - ring_flank_x6) + (ring_flank_x6^2 + ring_flank_y6^2) * (ring_flank_x5 - ring_flank_x4)) / (2 * (ring_flank_x4 * (ring_flank_y5 - ring_flank_y6) + ring_flank_x5 * (ring_flank_y6 - ring_flank_y4) + ring_flank_x6 * (ring_flank_y4 - ring_flank_y5)))

name: plate_radius
expr: min(center_distance + boss_radius + 3 mm, ring_tip_radius - fit_clearance - 0.5 mm)

name: planet_angle_1
expr: carrier_angle + 180 deg - 180 deg / planet_teeth - (input_angle - carrier_angle) * sun_teeth / planet_teeth

angle: if(print_layout, 0 deg, ((((2 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle) + 180 deg - 180 deg / planet_teeth - (input_angle - ((2 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) * sun_teeth / planet_teeth)) - planet_angle_1)
translate: if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * cos((2 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_x_1, center_distance * cos(((2 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_x_1)
if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * sin((2 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_y_1, center_distance * sin(((2 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_y_1)
name: Planet 2

angle: if(print_layout, 0 deg, ((((3 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle) + 180 deg - 180 deg / planet_teeth - (input_angle - ((3 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) * sun_teeth / planet_teeth)) - planet_angle_1)
translate: if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * cos((3 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_x_1, center_distance * cos(((3 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_x_1)
if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * sin((3 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_y_1, center_distance * sin(((3 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_y_1)
name: Planet 3

angle: if(print_layout, 0 deg, ((((4 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle) + 180 deg - 180 deg / planet_teeth - (input_angle - ((4 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) * sun_teeth / planet_teeth)) - planet_angle_1)
translate: if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * cos((4 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_x_1, center_distance * cos(((4 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_x_1)
if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * sin((4 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_y_1, center_distance * sin(((4 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_y_1)
name: Planet 4

angle: if(print_layout, 0 deg, ((((5 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle) + 180 deg - 180 deg / planet_teeth - (input_angle - ((5 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) * sun_teeth / planet_teeth)) - planet_angle_1)
translate: if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * cos((5 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_x_1, center_distance * cos(((5 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_x_1)
if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * sin((5 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_y_1, center_distance * sin(((5 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_y_1)
name: Planet 5

angle: if(print_layout, 0 deg, ((((6 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle) + 180 deg - 180 deg / planet_teeth - (input_angle - ((6 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) * sun_teeth / planet_teeth)) - planet_angle_1)
translate: if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * cos((6 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_x_1, center_distance * cos(((6 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_x_1)
if(print_layout, print_ring_radius * sin((6 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count) - planet_y_1, center_distance * sin(((6 - 1) * 360 deg / planet_count + carrier_angle)) - planet_y_1)
name: Planet 6
sun_fillet_area
expr: 0.5 * root_fillet * (sun_fillet_x * (sin(sun_p_angle * 1 rad) - sin(sun_q_angle * 1 rad)) - sun_fillet_y * (cos(sun_p_angle * 1 rad) - cos(sun_q_angle * 1 rad)) + root_fillet * (sun_p_angle - sun_q_angle))

name: sun_tooth_area
expr: 0.5 * sun_root_radius^2 * (2 * pi / sun_teeth - 2 * sun_root_half) + sun_tip_radius^2 * sun_tip_half + sun_base_radius^2 * (sun_tooth_ta^3 - sun_tooth_t0^3) / 3 + 2 * sun_fillet_area

name: planet_fillet_area
expr: 0.5 * root_fillet * (planet_fillet_x * (sin(planet_p_angle * 1 rad) - sin(planet_q_angle * 1 rad)) - planet_fillet_y * (cos(planet_p_angle * 1 rad) - cos(planet_q_angle * 1 rad)) + root_fillet * (planet_p_angle - planet_q_angle))

name: planet_tooth_area
expr: 0.5 * planet_root_radius^2 * (2 * pi / planet_teeth - 2 * planet_root_half) + planet_tip_radius^2 * planet_tip_half + planet_base_radius^2 * (planet_tooth_ta^3 - planet_tooth_t0^3) / 3 + 2 * planet_fillet_area

name: ring_fillet_area
expr: 0.5 * ring_fillet * (ring_fillet_x * (sin(ring_e_angle * 1 rad) - sin(ring_p_angle * 1 rad)) - ring_fillet_y * (cos(ring_e_angle * 1 rad) - cos(ring_p_angle * 1 rad)) + ring_fillet * (ring_e_angle - ring_p_angle))

name: ring_tooth_area
expr: 0.5 * ring_tip_radius^2 * (2 * pi / ring_teeth - 2 * ring_inner_half) + ring_root_radius^2 * ring_outer_half + ring_base_radius^2 * (ring_t_foot^3 - ring_t_tip^3) / 3 + 2 * ring_fillet_area

name: sun_bore_area
expr: pi * shaft_bore_radius^2 - (shaft_bore_radius^2 * acos((shaft_bore_radius - shaft_flat) / shaft_bore_radius) / 1 rad - (shaft_bore_radius - shaft_flat) * sqrt(shaft_bore_radius^2 - (shaft_bore_radius - shaft_flat)^2))

name: planet_volume_expected
expr: planet_height_shown * (planet_teeth * planet_tooth_area - pi * ledge_radius^2) - pi * ((planet_bearing_outside / 2)^2 - ledge_radius^2) * (planet_height_shown - (face_width - planet_bearing_width) / 2)

name: ring_section_expected
expr: pi * housing_radius^2 - ring_teeth * ring_tooth_area - bolt_count * pi * cover_screw_radius^2

name: contact_sun_planet
expr: (sqrt(sun_tip_radius^2 - sun_base_radius^2) + sqrt(planet_tip_radius^2 - planet_base_radius^2) - center_distance * sin(pressure_angle)) / (pi * tooth_module * cos(pressure_angle))

name: contact_planet_ring
expr: (sqrt(planet_tip_radius^2 - planet_base_radius^2) - sqrt(ring_tip_radius^2 - ring_base_radius^2) + center_distance * sin(pressure_angle)) / (pi * tooth_module * cos(pressure_angle))

name: sun_land_free
expr: 2 * sun_tip_radius * ((pi / 2 + 2 * sun_shift * tan(pressure_angle)) / sun_teeth + (tan(pressure_angle) - pressure_angle / 1 rad) - (tan(acos(sun_base_radius / sun_tip_radius)) - acos(sun_base_radius / sun_tip_radius) / 1 rad))

name: planet_land_free
expr: 2 * planet_tip_radius * ((pi / 2 + 2 * planet_shift * tan(pressure_angle)) / planet_teeth + (tan(pressure_angle) - pressure_angle / 1 rad) - (tan(acos(planet_base_radius / planet_tip_radius)) - acos(planet_base_radius / planet_tip_radius) / 1 rad))

name: backlash_max
expr: floor(100 * min(0.4 mm, min((sun_land_free - 0.4 mm) * 2 * sun_pitch_radius / sun_tip_radius, (planet_land_free - 0.4 mm) * 2 * planet_pitch_radius / planet_tip_radius)) / 1 mm) / 100 * 1 mm

name: sun_tip_land
expr: 2 * sun_tip_radius * ((pi / 2 + 2 * sun_shift * tan(pressure_angle)) / sun_teeth - backlash / (4 * sun_pitch_radius) + involute_pressure - (tan(sun_tip_pressure) - sun_tip_pressure / 1 rad))

name: planet_tip_land
expr: 2 * planet_tip_radius * ((pi / 2 + 2 * planet_shift * tan(pressure_angle)) / planet_teeth - backlash / (4 * planet_pitch_radius) + involute_pressure - (tan(planet_tip_pressure) - planet_tip_pressure / 1 rad))

name: ring_tip_check
expr: max(ring_pitch_radius - tooth_module * (1 - ring_shift), sqrt(ring_base_radius^2 + (center_distance * sin(pressure_angle))^2) + 0.02 * tooth_module)

name: ring_tip_land
expr: ring_tip_check * (2 * pi / ring_teeth - 2 * ((pi / 2 + 2 * ring_shift * tan(pressure_angle)) / ring_teeth + backlash / (4 * ring_pitch_radius) + involute_pressure - (tan(ring_tip_pressure_check) - ring_tip_pressure_check / 1 rad)))

name: trochoid_theta_1
expr: acos((ring_tip_radius^2 - planet_tip_radius^2 - center_distance^2) / (2 * center_distance * planet_tip_radius)) / 1 rad + tan(planet_tip_pressure) - planet_tip_pressure / 1 rad - involute_pressure

name: trochoid_theta_2
expr: acos((center_distance^2 + ring_tip_radius^2 - planet_tip_radius^2) / (2 * center_distance * ring_tip_radius)) / 1 rad

name: trochoid_margin
expr: trochoid_theta_1 * planet_teeth / ring_teeth + involute_pressure - (tan(ring_tip_pressure) - ring_tip_pressure / 1 rad) - trochoid_theta_2

motor
label: Motor
description: The stepper the reducer bolts to: mounting screws, pilot and shaft come from this row (NEMA sizes as most stepper makers build them).

name: module_row
label: Tooth size (module)
description: Size of the teeth (ISO 54 series I): a bigger module is stronger, needs a bigger housing and prints more easily. 1 mm suits a 0.4 mm nozzle only on a tuned printer; 2 mm needs a housing of about 150 mm.

name: reduction
label: Reduction
description: How many turns of the input for one turn of the output (ring held, sun in, carrier out). The teeth are chosen from it, so the form shows the reduction you really get beside it (see the output Reduction you get): usually within a few percent.

name: housing_diameter
label: Housing outer diameter
description: The reducer's overall diameter. The teeth, bearings and output grow from it. The smallest housing depends on the reduction, the tooth size and the motor; the largest is 160 mm, so every plate fits a 220 mm bed (142 mm at module 1, where the ring has its most teeth).

name: planet_count
label: Planets
description: Number of planet gears, evenly spaced. Tooth counts are chosen so this many planets always assemble ((sun + ring) / planets whole); the upper limit is where neighbouring planets would touch.

name: input_angle
label: Turn the input
description: Drag it: the sun turns, the planets roll round it, and the carrier and output turn the same way by this angle divided by the reduction.

name: face_width
label: Gear width
description: Tooth face width: wider teeth carry more, the housing grows in height. The planet bearing must fit in the width.

name: backlash
label: Backlash
description: Play between meshing teeth on the pitch circle (printed gears need 0.1 to 0.25 mm). The teeth are thinned by this amount in total.

name: fit_clearance
label: Print clearance
description: Radial gap for running fits: the carrier plates in the ring and the sun in the carrier opening. Tune it for your printer.

name: show
label: Show
description: Cutaway: the reducer on its motor, cut through the middle of the gears so you see them mesh. Closed: as it is used. Print plates 1 to 6: the printed parts in print orientation, one plate at a time, each within a 220 x 220 mm bed; export the model as 3MF from each plate.
choices: Print plate 5: output hub and flange

title: Planetary gearbox
author: 3DCraft Jigs
description: A printable single-stage planetary reducer for a NEMA stepper, built from the reduction and the size you want: true involute teeth with profile shift so no tooth is undercut, a planet count that always assembles, a ring gear that keeps its teeth clear of the planets, ball bearings on steel pins, a carrier on the output bearings, and a slider that turns the input and every gear by the true kinematics. To print: set Show to Print plate 1, export the model as 3MF (File > Export, The model), and do the same for plates 2 to 6; each plate fits a 220 x 220 mm bed. Export STEP in the Closed view for CAD.
